accountingRules: memory.peak is a lifetime high-water and memory.current/stat at later reads describe another instant; no exact peak decomposition is inferred.
memory.stat.file already includes shmem; report shmem as a subset. fileMinusShmem is an arithmetic display of recorded counters, not proof of a particular engine allocation.
Node external includes ArrayBuffers; never add external+arrayBuffers. heapUsed/heapTotal are V8 allocation metrics, not an additive partition of RSS or group memory.
Process RSS includes shared/mapped pages. Do not sum process RSS or separate process lifetime peaks into a group peak. Parent postgres RSS is not all database children.
Node callbacks/heap snapshots at before/after/ACK are natural-GC-stage dependent; live retained bytes or allocator capacity do not follow from these snapshots.
Group native snapshot precedes metric SQL/ACK; the associated Node boundary snapshot is after ACK. They are explicitly sequential, not simultaneous.
